title: L3Harris Receives SATCOM Order from US Army to Support Key Command and Control Program
summary: L3Harris Technologies has received a $36 million order in support of the U.S. Army for the Hawkeye™ 4 Lite satellite communications terminal. The contract will field under the Command and Control Network Optimized for Warfighting (C2NOW) initiative by enhancing secure, seamless SATCOM interoperability between U.S. and NATO partners.
body_markdown:
**MELBOURNE, Fla., Nov. 3, 2026** — L3Harris Technologies (NYSE: LHX) has received a $36 million order in support of the U.S. Army for the Hawkeye™ 4 Lite satellite communications terminal. The contract will field under the Command and Control Network Optimized for Warfighting (C2NOW) initiative by enhancing secure, seamless SATCOM interoperability between U.S. and NATO partners.


“L3Harris is ready to support the Army with resilient, expeditionary communications capabilities that align with its modernization priorities,” said Faisal Munir, President, Mission Critical Communications, Communications & Spectrum Dominance, L3Harris.


The Army’s satellite configuration will use a rapidly deployable Hawkeye 4 Lite terminal with field-swappable components to allow greater flexibility and adaptability in dynamic operational environments.
